title: Likes and preferences
function: Express what you like and dislike

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to express likes, dislikes and preferences using like, love, hate and would like.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I like reading books. She loves dancing. They hate waiting. I would like a coffee, please. Notice like/love/hate can be followed by -ing, and would like by a noun or to + verb.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: After love, like, hate we usually use the -ing form.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences about things you like, love or hate.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I ___ like a glass of water, please.
phases.explanation: Would like is the polite form to ask for something.
